preconditions.description: The input contains a single integer N representing the number of attractions, where 3 <= N <= 20.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.strip().splitlines()) == N and all(len(line.split()) == N for line in stdout.strip().splitlines())
postconditions.description: The output consists of exactly N lines, each containing exactly N space-separated integers, forming an N x N matrix.

postconditions.expression: all(int(row[i]) == 0 for row in [line.split() for line in stdout.strip().splitlines()] for i in range(N))
postconditions.description: The diagonal elements of the matrix are all zero.

postconditions.expression: all(int(row[i]) == int(row[j]) for row in [line.split() for line in stdout.strip().splitlines()] for i in range(N) for j in range(N) if i != j and int(row[i]) == int(row[j]))
postconditions.description: The matrix is symmetric, meaning the price from attraction i to j equals the price from j to i.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(row[i]) <= 1000 for row in [line.split() for line in stdout.strip().splitlines()] for i in range(N) if i != row.index(row[i]) if int(row[i]) != 0)
postconditions.description: All non-diagonal elements are positive integers not exceeding 1000.

postconditions.expression: len(set(int(row[i]) for row in [line.split() for line in stdout.strip().splitlines()] for i in range(N) if int(row[i]) != 0)) == N * (N - 1) // 2
postconditions.description: All non-diagonal edge weights are pairwise distinct.

postconditions.expression: len(set(sum(int(row[i]) for i, row in enumerate([line.split() for line in stdout.strip().splitlines()]) for j in range(N) if i != j and j in [k for k in range(N) if k != i and k != j])) for _ in range(1))
postconditions.description: The sum of edge weights for any Hamiltonian cycle (visiting every node exactly once and returning to the start) is constant, regardless of the cycle chosen.
